messages:
Maya (Head of Strategy): Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands. Post any remaining questions on mission, market positioning, and competitor stance here.
Sam (Sales): Thanks Maya. Two quick asks: 1) a single-sentence positioning line we can put in external decks, 2) any updated guidance on reserved capacity discounts?
Asha (CEO): For decks: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." Keep it outcome-focused.
Priya (VP Product): On discounts: pilots only this quarter. We're evaluating commit tiers and SLA add-ons with early customers; no public changes yet.
Nina (Solutions Eng): From customer calls: teams ask when to pick Dedicated vs Private. Can we give a crisp one-paragraph recommendation?
Maya (Head of Strategy): Short recommendation: Dedicated = predictable throughput & isolation when you need committed capacity; Private = full network/data isolation and compliance (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads. Hosted = fastest onboarding and experimentation.
Marco (CTO): Tech note: Private deployments may need customization of kernel selection and quantization settings per site. That adds onboarding time vs hosted.
Sam (Sales): Competitor question: reps want a simple way to talk about our difference from managed model endpoints (cloud vendors) without naming names. Any suggested bullets?
Asha (CEO): Public messaging: 1) predictable unit economics (cost per token controls), 2) unified runtime across deployment modes, 3) rollouts + quality guards for production. Avoid direct callouts.
Priya (VP Product): Add: first-class observability for per-route latency and token cost, plus canary/eval-driven rollouts. That resonates with platform teams.
Nina (Solutions Eng): Can we get a short FAQ doc for sales to use in demos (5 bullets)? I can turn it into a playbook.
Maya (Head of Strategy): Yes. Nina and Priya coordinate on a 5-bullet FAQ. Aim for one side of a slide.
Sam (Sales): One more: what usage metrics should customers use to decide to move from Hosted to Dedicated?
Marco (CTO): Practical signal: sustained request concurrency and token volume driving >X% of spend where latency variability or throughput limits affect SLAs. We'll make a short metrics checklist.
Maya (Head of Strategy): We'll publish the checklist in the roadmap doc. Expect a link in this thread by Friday.
ops-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2212349000 :white_check_mark:
Asha (CEO): Thanks team. If there are no more major asks I'll hand this back to Maya to collate materials.
Maya (Head of Strategy): Collating now 1: will ping when FAQ and checklist are ready.
